elsewhere.note: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”
If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
